professionalSummary: Frontend engineer on the design system team of a software company for three years, implementing components against product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard. (src_7f76af7a4abf)
experienceHighlights: Implemented twenty-six components against product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard. (src_7f76af7a4abf)
Wrote accessibility tests and visual regression tests for each component, with test results attached to each component's pull request and checked by the accessibility specialist. (src_38f51edaa4c2)
Reviewed product teams' contributions to the library as one of the team's three reviewers; release approval remained with the design system lead, recorded in the release record. (src_3eb8d4b9a46b)
Supported product teams' adoption of new components through adoption office hours and migration guides, recording migrations in the adoption log. (src_5b131766efca)
Wrote limitation notes and hand-over conditions for each library release in the release record. (src_30ffb5542596)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: three component pull requests with their test results and review records, one release record with its limitation note, and the adoption log for one quarter, with repository references as a verification trail. (src_60035a4c85aa)
